biography.value:
Description

Shiva is the patron saint and primal of the Harriers. She was summoned by Ysayle in the image of an ancient saint who was beloved of Hraesvelgr, as part of her goal to end the millennium-long Dragonsong War. Unlike the Primals summoned by beast-tribes, Ysayle uses her own body as a vessel for Shiva's spirit.

Defense

AC 34, touch 13; flat-footed 29 (-2 size, +5 dex, +21 natural)

hp 630 [756] (21d12+126)

Fort +18, Ref +17, Will +21

DR 10/-

Immune Ice

Resist Dark 20, Holy 10, Lightning 10, Water 20, Wind 15, Earth 15, wind 50%

SR 30

Weakness Fire

Offense

Speed 40 ft.

Melee Frost Band +29/+24/+19 (3d6+10/17-20 plus 1d6 ice damage) or Frost Staff +29/+24/+19 (3d8+15 plus 1d6 ice damage)

Ranged Ice Bow +29/+24/+19 (3d8+2/x3 plus 1d8 ice damage)

Space 15 ft.; Reach 10 ft.

Special Attacks Absolute Zero, Avalanche, Dreams of Ice, Diamond Dust, Glacier Bash, Glass Dance, Hailstorm, Heavenly Strike, Shatter, Whiteout

Special Abilities Bow Form, Staff Form, Sword Form

Burst Mode Permafrost

Statistics

Base Atk +21; CMB +26; CMD 41

SQ Outsider Traits, Does not Breathe, Does not Eat, Does not Sleep

Languages Auroran, Common, and 4 others

Once below 50% hp (378), This Burst Mode lets Shiva freeze the surround area around her, making the ground difficult to move on and having her take the advantage. For a number of rounds equal to 1 + 1 round for every four HD, Shiva creates the area 300-ft.-radius around herself to become ice. She gains icewalking, doubles the damage on Hailstorm, add an additional 1d6 points of ice damage per her weapon attacks, and every physical attack inflicts frozen for 1d4 rounds (Fort DC 29). This limit break requires only a swift action to activate. Even after this wears off the surrounding area remains icy and she keeps icewalking.
